scope: Plain-language copy for provider service listings and seeker requests, including their edit forms and shared location, travel, arrangement and payment fields.
changes: Who will travel? uses wording from the current workspace user's point of view.
Location labels explain whether to select a general area or mark an exact place; seeker-visit requests explain that the provider supplies their address in the offer.
Travel distance uses Up to … km and No distance limit, with the measurement origin explained.
Travel fee and optional extra travel budget explain whose trip is covered, when fees apply, and the single-total request quote.
Headings, field labels, examples, validation messages, timing options and payment descriptions use familiar language.
Field limits appear before submission and are associated with inputs for assistive technology.
Stored values, form validation rules, API payloads and service-arrangement behavior are preserved.

verification.tests: 129 distinct focused tests passed: 112 listing/location/booking/request tests and 17 background refresh tests.
verification.typescript: Passed no-emit check with incremental compilation disabled.
verification.eslint: Passed all 15 changed production TypeScript files.
verification.diffCheck: Passed; existing CRLF normalization warning is informational.
verification.testMaintenance: Updated existing accessible-name expectations. An older admin refresh fixture now expects the current audit empty-state copy; its pending Promise explicitly uses never to support the typed audit API.

browserChecks: Real form components and existing styles rendered in a temporary local Vite preview with a sample account and no-op publishing functions.
Reviewed desktop provider and seeker forms and 390px phone views in light and dark themes.
All three arrangement choices expose the appropriate wording and fields for each workspace.
Seeker visits provider explains the search area and provider address, and hides the extra travel budget.
Provider visits seeker uses a general service area and travel distance; visits to the provider use an exact location; flexible listings expose both location and distance.
No horizontal document overflow at 390px or the additional 320px seeker check.
limitations: The preview uses illustrative context and Arial, the existing Next Geist fallback, rather than a physical device or authenticated publishing session. No real listing was submitted. Temporary preview files, server and browser tab were removed after review.
